steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your degree level. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you document your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp coursework, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion to ensure accuracy and timely processing.

Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning paths and recertification support to help you stay current and advance your career in Trenton's public sector, healthcare, and industrial sectors.
